capabilities.title: Poll a project tracker and run autonomous implementation work in isolated issue workspaces
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md describes polling Linear, creating one workspace per issue, and running an agent until the issue reaches a terminal state
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not autonomously claim external issues, edit repositories, or advance tracker state. Those actions require an operator-owned development workflow and explicit mutation authority.

capabilities.title: Require proof-of-work handoff details such as tests, review feedback, complexity, and walkthrough evidence
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md proof-of-work guidance and SPEC.md run lifecycle and observability contracts

capabilities.title: Run multiple isolated issue implementations concurrently under explicit concurrency limits
capabilities.sourceEvidence: SPEC.md worker orchestration and configurable maximum concurrent agents
capabilities.reason: Nexus permits only bounded, non-mutating advisory specialists inside one MAX-controlled request. Concurrent autonomous repository mutation and synchronized landing are outside the product's authority boundary.

capabilities.title: Isolate each work item in its own workspace and supply only the context required for that run
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md isolated workspace per issue and SPEC.md workspace lifecycle

capabilities.title: Use Codex as the autonomous implementation runner behind a tracker-driven service
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README.md positions Symphony as a Codex orchestration service and engineering preview for trusted environments
capabilities.reason: Nexus remains provider-neutral and local-first. All model traffic must stay behind lib/ai.ts with Ollama and optional BYOK providers rather than requiring a Codex-only autonomous service.
